## Review

_Congratulations, you've completed this exercise and learned a lot about **Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP)** development!_

<img src="https://octodex.github.com/images/jetpacktocat.png" alt="celebrate" width=200 align=right>

Here's a recap of your accomplishments:

- ✅ Set up **Koin** for dependency injection with a clean, modular architecture
- ✅ Integrated **Ktor** for network requests and **Kotlin Coroutines** for asynchronous programming
- ✅ Implemented **SQLDelight** for local data persistence with platform-specific drivers
- ✅ Built a complete **Repository pattern** with network-first caching strategy
- ✅ Created a **ViewModel** with StateFlow for reactive UI state management
- ✅ Wrote comprehensive tests for data sources and repositories
- ✅ Learned clean architecture principles for multiplatform projects
